text:
alex: Quick async pulse — starting traffic attenuation sweep for canary-3 now. primary goal: confirm latency/5xx behavior under 10%->25% traffic. pinging cross-team for quick status.
maria: On it. Preflight looked good. I ran the healthcheck script against the canary stacks ~10m ago. No OOMs.
sam: I see a small uptick in p50 on one pod (~30ms -> ~95ms) after the first shift, investigating logs. grabbing a filtered trace now.
jen: FYI the feature-flag gating is set to gradual_rollout=true, config matches rollout-plan v2.0. No DB migrations on this path.
deploy-bot: [notification] canary-3 rollout: traffic shifted to 10% at 2005006789. monitor endpoint: https://ops.internal/rollouts/canary-3
maria: Metrics snapshot (promql):
```
avg_over_time(request_duration_ms[5m]) by (pod)
```
Nothing alarming except sam's pod.
sam: Found a noisy GC cycle on pod canary-3-7. Stacktrace points to a hot path in the tokenizer cache. Restarting that pod now (kubectl rollout restart).
alex: Good catch. Maria — can you watch error-rate (5xx) and queue length for next 10m? Sam, ping when restart completes.
maria: Watching. current 5xx = 0.18% (baseline 0.12%). queue length stable. Will alert if >0.5% or queue doubles.
sam: Pod restarted at 2005006920. Warmup appears fine, p50 back near baseline.
jen: Reconfirming feature flag state across regions: eu-west and us-east both set to 25% target but we're ramping to 25% only in us-east first per plan. eu-west remains at 0 until hold cleared.
alex: OK. Plan: hold at 10% for 15m, verify error/latency/ops traces, then 25% in us-east. If all green, propagate to eu-west after 1h. Any blockers?
maria: One note — SLO alert threshold for small spikes is aggressive. Recommend temp silence on minor p50 blips during ramp to avoid pager noise. @jen agree?
jen: Agree; I'll mute p50 noise for the next 30m and keep the SLI/5xx alerts live. Documenting in runbook.
sam: No further issues from my side. Observability spans look healthy.
deploy-bot: [notification] canary-3 traffic adjusted to 10% -> hold at 10% at 2005007000 per manual-step.
alex: Great. Next check at +15m. If anyone sees >0.5% 5xx or sustained p50 >200ms, call the rollback play. Otherwise we'll proceed with 25% in us-east. :thumbsup:
maria: Copy, will update if anything changes.
jen: I'll post the exact mute window to the incident channel and update the rollout doc.
sam: thumbs up. good sweep.
alex: Thanks team — keeping this async saved the sync. I'll post final status in 30m or earlier if issues.
